components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid accent CTA — auth submit, dashboard upload/upgrade actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background-color: #3F6B4F; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px 32px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3F6B4F; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered neutral action — dashboard secondary actions, upgrade button at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background-color: #FFFFFF; color: #0F172A; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #F8FAFC; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3F6B4F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field — auth forms, dashboard search. Focus shifts border to primary green.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #CBD5E1; background-color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: #0F172A; outline: none; transition: all 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94A3B8; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #3F6B4F; background-color: #E9F2EC; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #DC2626; background-color: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation link, at-rest / hover / active states.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; color: #475569; transition: all 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background-color: #E6EDE8; } .ds-nav-item--active { background-color: #EFF4F0; color: #3F6B4F; } .ds-nav-item--active .ds-nav-label { font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: AI Attribution Banner
components.description: Signature component: marks AI-generated content (rewrite suggestions, AI pill) with the sage-tint treatment — the system's only intentional departure from plain neutral surfaces.
components.html: AI-suggested rewrite
components.css: .ds-ai-banner { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #3F6B4F; background-color: #E9F2EC; border: 1px solid #BBD3C5; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Card / Panel
components.description: Standard bordered flat container — dashboard hero card, resume panel, feature card.
components.css: .ds-card { background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 32px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 24px; color: #0F172A; margin: 0; }

components.name: Score Badge
components.description: Semantic status chip for resume-analysis scores — deliberately a separate palette from the brand accent, even where the hue is also green.
components.css: .ds-score-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid; } .ds-score-badge--excellent { color: #16A34A; background-color: rgb(22 163 74 / 0.1); border-color: rgb(22 163 74 / 0.2); } .ds-score-badge--good { color: #CA8A04; background-color: rgb(202 138 4 / 0.1); border-color: rgb(202 138 4 / 0.2); } .ds-score-badge--needs-work { color: #EA580C; background-color: rgb(234 88 12 / 0.1); border-color: rgb(234 88 12 / 0.2); }

narrative.overview:
Minimal and precise. Every surface is flat and quiet — no shadows exist anywhere in this system; depth comes only from a 1px border and a shift to a slightly darker neutral fill, never a blur. One accent color, a muted forest green, is the only thing on screen that means "this is active, this is yours to act on." Everything else — body copy, panels, dividers, icons at rest — lives in restrained slate neutrals. Micro-metadata (timestamps, tiers, table headers, score labels) is set in uppercase mono type, a small but deliberate technical accent against the otherwise humanist sans body.

This reads as a tool, not a marketing surface: for an audience of anxious early-career job seekers, the product earns trust by staying out of the way — no flourish competing with the resume content itself.
keyCharacteristics: Exactly one accent hue (muted forest green), applied sparingly to primary actions, active nav state, links, and AI-attributed content
Zero shadows; flat surfaces distinguished only by border and fill-tone shifts
Uppercase mono-label type as the system's one "technical" accent (timestamps, tiers, table headers, tags)
Generous internal padding (24–48px) inside cards and page shells; nothing feels cramped

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Muted Forest Green is the only color that means "act here." It never appears as a decorative fill, illustration color, or background wash outside the dedicated sage-tint role.

rules.name: The AI Tint Rule
rules.body: Any surface presenting AI-generated or AI-attributed content gets the Soft Sage Tint background + border + primary-colored text/icon treatment. It is the one visual signal that says "this came from the model, not the user's own data" — don't reuse it for plain informational panels.

rules.name: The Mono Metadata Rule
rules.body: Any uppercase, letter-spaced micro-label (timestamps, table headers, tags, dividers) is set in JetBrains Mono at 11px. Inter never takes this role.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow is used for depth, ever. If a surface needs to read as "above" another, use a border and a fill-tone step, not a shadow.

dos: Do keep Muted Forest Green as the only accent hue in the system — one voice, used sparingly.
Do signal AI-attributed content with the Soft Sage Tint treatment, and reserve that treatment for AI content only.
Do use JetBrains Mono, uppercase, for metadata micro-labels; keep everything else in Inter.
Do convey depth with a border and a fill-tone step — never a shadow.
donts: Don't add box-shadow for elevation anywhere in this system; it has none today.
Don't introduce a second accent hue for "variety" — expressiveness comes from weight, size, and the mono-label device, not more color.
Don't reuse a score-badge color as a UI action color, or vice versa — they are a separate semantic palette from the brand accent, even though score-excellent is also a green.
Don't use the Soft Sage Tint for plain informational panels that aren't AI-attributed — it would dilute its one job as the "this is AI" signal.
